messages:
Alice M.: Quick FYI — we're going to canary a smart-assign change that holds assignment until enrichment completes (to reduce bad-owner churn). Canaries start in 10m for 20% of inbound leads. I'll post updates. :eyes:
Priya G.: timeline? how long will leads sit unassigned if enrichment lags?
Miguel R.: Canary policy: hold assignment up to 45s waiting for enrichment; if enrichment doesn't finish, fallback to round-robin overflow. Rollout is 20% -> 50% -> 100% by success metrics.
Jenna S.: Sales heads up — if a lead is unassigned for >30s send SMS alert to SDR on-call? we can tweak after first run.
Sam Ops: Added a short-term alert to route to #marketing if unassigned_ratio > 0.15 for 5m. Also added a heartbeat for the enrichment pipeline.
Miguel R.: HubSpot/SF mapping note: we're preserving original source mapping so owner attribution doesn't break on fallback. If anyone has mapping edgecases (partner leads etc) ping me.
Priya G.: Can you paste the workflow condition you'll use in HubSpot? want to update our docs and handoff playbook.
Miguel R.: Sure — HubSpot workflow sample:
```
Trigger: new lead
If: property(enriched) != true
Action: wait 30s
Then: if enriched == true -> assign by smart-assign
Else -> assign to "Overflow RR" queue and tag fallback_reason=ENRICH_TIMEOUT
```
Jenna S.: tagging plan looks good. can we also add a 'fallback_notified=true' property when overflow assign happens so we can filter in SF?
Miguel R.: Yep will set fallback_notified=true via the RR webhook payload.
Sam Ops: Prometheus alert added (copy):
```
alert: HighUnassignedLeads
expr: sum by(job) (rate(lead_unassigned_total[5m])) / sum by(job) (rate(lead_ingested_total[5m])) > 0.15
for: 5m
labels: { team: "marketing" }
annotations: { summary: "High fraction of unassigned leads" }
```
HubSpot Bot: Workflow "Smart Assign Canary" created by Miguel R. — ID 15321 — https://app.hubspot.com/workflows/15321
Priya G.: Thanks. I'll update the inbound routing doc and add a short-run checklist (what to watch, who to ping).
Alice M.: After first 30m run let's meet quick — 15m sync in #marketing — to decide whether to expand or rollback. I'll share a tiny dashboard with assign latency + fallback rate. :thumbsup:
Jenna S.: ack — SDRs on standby. :phone:
Sam Ops: I'll post the alert playbook and how to mute during expected testing window.
Miguel R.: Rolling in 8m. tagging @here in 5m for final go/no-go.
Alice M.: Great — thanks team. If you see anything odd DM me directly. :rotating_light:
